text_block_list.text:
While buying ingredients to make snacks for Super Creek
to eat between training sessions—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, carrying so much luggage...
Are you having a party or something?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
If you had just told me, I would have made it for you.
Please don't hesitate to ask me for anything, okay?
choice_data_list: I thought you could have this between training sessions.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Huh? Does that mean... it's for me...?

Nutritional intake during training is vital for conditioning.
And since we're doing it, I want her to enjoy delicious food
without getting tired of it—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
And for that reason, instead of buying nutritional supplements,
you decided to make them by hand?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my!
Thank you very much, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Who I am today is all thanks to your
hard work, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Because they study so much, think things through so deeply for me,
and share so much of their energy with me.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I suppose I ought to
give something in return as well~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
To heal your mind and body, Trainer,
here's a thank-you packed with love... Fufu♪
